# Shrink-only ledger of the duplicate paths in cmd/nova-sprint, internal/sprint/...,
# cmd/nova-friend and internal/friend: one row per pair, `<file:func> <file:func> <why>`.
# The class test internal/ci/duplicate_paths_class_test.go reads every non-test function
# body, normalises it (identifiers renamed in order of first use, literals kept, comments
# dropped), and holds a pair of bodies of at least eight statements whose hash occurs twice.
# It also holds two verbs whose help usage line is one line under two names. A pair not
# listed here is red; a row whose pair is gone is stale. The deletion card for each pair is
# named after the why and written in docs/STOPGAPS.md, "duplicate paths". The list only shrinks.
